entities.summary: "I'm Your Man" is a song by the English pop duo Wham!, released on 11 November 1985, via Epic Records in the United Kingdom and most of the world, and Columbia Records in the United States. It was written and produced by George Michael. It was released a single for the albums Music from the Edge of Heaven, released in North America and Japan, and The Final, released in Australasia and Europe.
